verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside Honeybadger that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server (docs-13, docs-30) lets an external AI assistant reach Honeybadger data, which is a different product role. The "Describe your search" panel (docs-5) turns a plain-language description into an error query, but it is not described as AI and is a narrow search feature, not a task-delegation assistant. Both are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
